description: Matched delayed-outcome credit experiment with owner-side residual training mode=ssl-rl-alternating. Both credit arms consume the same frozen-substrate rollouts; only the credit assignment unit differs. The causal rollout keeps the learned switch unit as beta owner; Internal RL supplies z candidates without replacing beta boundaries. Structured subgoals remain evaluation-only and never supervise beta. The current TrainingTrace contract has no expert action target, so SSL predicts a projected next-residual-vector proxy and the strict Eq.3 supervision gate remains closed.
